decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - A detailed survey showing all features of the building (including photographic records where relevant) clearly indicating which are to be removed prior to the commencement of development.

Condition : 4 - Details of the external appearance of the northeast elevation of the baths and to house 4, together with elevational details of house 6 (including all fenestration) shall be submitted and and approved by the LPA prior to commencement of development. All development shall be carried out in accordance with these details.
Condition : 5 - Details of the restoration of any plaques or other similar features shall be submitted to and approved by the LPA. All works shall be carried out in accordance with these details.

Condition : 6 - A schedule of repairs to the building should be submitted to and approved by the LPA before any works commences. All the works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 7 - A window and door schedule of all existing and proposed at a scale of 1:20 shall be submitted and agreed in writing by the LPA before any works commence, and the approved details shall be implemented in accordance with that scheme.

Condition : 8 - Details of the sliding timber screens and glazing shall be submitted to and approved by the LPA before any works commence, and the works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved scheme before any part of the development is occupied.

Condition : 9 - Full details of the new floor and associated fixings over the pool area shall be sumitted to the LPA before any works commence the works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved scheme before the building is occupied.

Condition : 10 - Sample panels of brickwork showing the proposed colour, texture, face bond and pointing shall be provided on site and approved by the LPA before any works commence, and the sample panel shall be retained on site until the works are completed.l

Condition : 11 - A sample roof tile showing the proposed colour and texture shall be provided on site and approved in writing by the LPA before any works commence, and the works shall be carried out in accordance with that approval.
description: Conversion and alterations of existing building into offices and two 1 bedroom houses, one 2 bedroom houses, one 3 bedroom houses.  Demolition of existing single storey changing block and construction one bedroom houses, alterations and refurbishment of existing residential unit and associated parking.
